# Paul Wronski

> Paul Wronski is an independent creative director who runs an agency of one, based in Ridgefield, Connecticut. He helps companies from startup to enterprise strengthen the brand, website, marketing systems, and AI-enabled creative that shape how they are understood, trusted, and remembered. Work is done directly by the principal, with continuity of creative judgment, context, and execution. Also available as a fractional creative director.

## What the studio does

- Brand identity and positioning
- Websites and digital experiences
- Marketing and campaign systems
- Creative systems and AI-enabled workflows (for example, custom AI image-generation systems that follow a brand's standards)
- Ongoing senior creative leadership

## Who it is for

- B2B technology, health tech, fintech, and professional services companies, from startup through mid-market to enterprise, building credibility and differentiation
- Marketing, brand, and product leaders (directors, VPs, CMOs) who need senior creative direction without agency overhead
- Companies at an inflection point: post-acquisition, post-pivot, or entering a new market
- Teams without a creative lead who need experienced direction without a full-time hire

## Engagements and pricing

- Goals: one clearly defined outcome delivered as accomplishments-as-a-service. Starts at $3,500.
- Sprints: focused engagements for bigger creative challenges such as repositioning, a new identity, a website, or a campaign. Starts at $15,000.
- Integrated partnerships: ongoing creative direction embedded with your team. Starts at $6,000 per month. This is the preferred model.
